measuredNoteEdits.reason: "I am" is sung on one held E4 with no break (as in verses 1 and 3); the loudness steps down from 0.46 to 0.30 at 22.17-22.19 s where the vowel changes. Without this the matcher put "am" on the next A4 and "here" on a 0.10 s piece.
Every verse sings "here" on the A4 that follows "I am" (14.20, 31.31, 39.86 s).

"How do you do" starts on the B3 after the breath in every verse (15.36, 23.92, 32.45, 40.95 s). Here that B3 is at 58.05 s; the last "do" (A3) is too quiet to be measured, so the matcher had pulled "How" back onto the E4 of "I am".
